prompts.text: Name a dish you'd order at a hawker centre
prompts.note: Main dishes and snacks. Drinks and desserts don't count here.

prompts.text: Name a kueh (traditional local cake or snack)
prompts.note: Chinese, Nonya or Malay kueh all count.

prompts.text: Name a drink you'd order at a kopitiam or hawker drink stall
prompts.note: Freshly made drinks, not canned or bottled ones. Sweetness/ice add-ons count as the base drink — 'kopi-o kosong peng' is Kopi-O.

prompts.text: Kopitiam lingo: name a word you add to 'kopi' or 'teh' when ordering
prompts.note: Just the add-on word (e.g. the 'O' in kopi-o) — the full order like 'kopi-o kosong' also counts.

prompts.text: Name a local dessert you'd get at a hawker centre or dessert stall
prompts.note: A few famous kueh count here too.

prompts.text: Name something you can pick at a yong tau foo stall
prompts.note: Stuffed or plain both count — 'stuffed bitter gourd' is Bitter Gourd.

prompts.text: Name a dish you'd find at a cai png (economic rice) stall
prompts.note: Also called economy rice or mixed rice.

prompts.text: Name a type of noodle you can choose at a local noodle stall
prompts.note: E.g. what you'd pick at a fishball noodle or bak chor mee stall.
